, Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted the clue about “eight consecutive weeks,” framing searches as if “Yeah!” was behind another song, when the fact is the reverse: Usher’s “Yeah!” (the lead single from Confessions) kept “Burn” at No. 2 for eight consecutive weeks before “Burn” took over No. 1. This reversed logic led to repeatedly incorrect search queries and failure to verify the correct eight-week detail, steering the process toward a wrong/uncertain conclusion.
